Title: Register with valid details and land on login
Steps: 1. Open /auth/register 2. Enter Tushaar Gupta + unique email + Valid#12345 3. Submit
ExpectedResult: User is redirected to login page

Title: Login and verify profile information
Steps: 1. Login with registered credentials 2. Open Account > Profile 3. Check first name last name email
ExpectedResult: Profile shows Tushaar Gupta and registered email

Title: CoD checkout with Confirm pressed twice shows invoice
Steps: 1. Proceed cart → sign-in → address → payment 2. Select Cash on Delivery 3. Confirm twice 4. Open My Invoices

Title: Register with already-used email is rejected
Steps: 1. Open register 2. Submit form using existing email
ExpectedResult: Error shown; user not registered again

Title: Login with incorrect password is rejected
Steps: 1. Open login 2. Enter email + wrong password 3. Submit

Title: Single Confirm does not generate invoice yet
Preconditions: Logged-in user at payment CoD step
Steps: 1. Select Cash on Delivery 2. Click Confirm once only
ExpectedResult: Payment success may show; invoice number not yet

Title: API register login token and create cart
Steps: 1. POST /users/register 2. POST /users/login 3. POST /carts with Bearer token

Title: API add product and generate invoice with fixture body
Steps: 1. GET /products 2. Add product 3. POST /invoices with guide payload
ExpectedResult: Cart has items; invoice id returned
